public_pipeline.name: Hunter-Central Coast Renewable Energy Zone network infrastructure
public_pipeline.where: Upper Hunter to Central Coast, incl. Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Port Stephens

public_pipeline.electrical: HV transmission and sub-transmission, substations, protection and control, comms and fibre, construction power. Tier-1 principal contractors — target subcontract packages, not the head contract.

public_pipeline.name: John Hunter Health and Innovation Precinct

public_pipeline.name: Belmont Desalination Plant
public_pipeline.electrical: HV supply and substation, MCCs and VSDs for high-pressure pumping, SCADA and instrumentation, hazardous-area work, standby generation.

public_pipeline.detail: Includes new bridges over the Hunter River.
public_pipeline.electrical: Road and high-mast lighting, ITS and variable message signage power, communications pits and conduit, tunnel/underpass services.

public_pipeline.where: Muswellbrook (Upper Hunter — outside core coverage, watch item)
public_pipeline.electrical: Road lighting, intersection and signal power, comms infrastructure.

public_pipeline.detail: Full hospital redevelopment in the coverage area.
public_pipeline.electrical: Essential and standby supply, body-protected wiring, nurse call, theatre and imaging power, data, security.

public_pipeline.name: Singleton bypass
public_pipeline.detail: New Hunter River crossing and bypass alignment.

public_pipeline.where: Williamtown to Bobs Farm, Port Stephens
